verdict.rationale: A tax and customs portal could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled or recurring submissions, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows sign-in, informational services, and opting into electronic notifications and communication channels. Receiving notifications is an adjacent feature, not user-configurable automations that run autonomously, so nothing in the pack supports this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
